_notes: Section 7.48.8: a HEAD-TO-HEAD, which is the instrument the composition search needed and never had. Spread over ten compositions, each one gets a tenth of the rounds and reads +-3.2, so a difference between two cells carries +-4.5 -- and every move the search has chased since Section 7.28 is smaller than that. Two compositions over 1600 rounds put 800 on each side: +-1.8 a side, +-2.5 on the difference, for the same running time. Change the two compositions to ask a different question. Every number here is measured, not a placeholder.
